cognitive_observation.label: Cognitive observation
cognitive_observation.note: Read-only world/embodiment observation; no learning or control authority.

visual_embodiment.label: Visual Embodiment V1
visual_embodiment.note: Godot consumes canonical FK points/segments. This public page replays the same FK truth as a web projection.

dance_gate1.label: Solo Jazz execution
dance_gate1.note: Canonical MotorOS executes one deterministic eight-count bounce/pulse/support-intent phrase. Engineering reference only; not professional Solo Jazz validation.

dance_gate2_music.label: Solo Jazz MusicMap conductor
dance_gate2_music.note: Validated MusicMap timing requests approved tempo-adaptive Solo Jazz MotorOS phrases. Music/browser layers have no joint-write authority. Gate 2 is scheduling infrastructure, not full-song professional musicality.

dance_gate3_vocabulary.label: Solo Jazz vocabulary
dance_gate3_vocabulary.note: The approved vocabulary contains two mechanically distinct MotorOS phrases with deterministic section-aware selection and canonical dance-neutral transitions. Engineering benchmark only; not full Solo Jazz vocabulary or professional choreography.

dance_gate4_support.label: Solo Jazz support evidence
dance_gate4_support.note: Canonical FK foot proximity, contacted-foot slide proxy and controller joint-rate evidence gate later phrase launches. These are engineering observations, not force-plate, friction or professional balance validation.

dance_gate5_semantics.label: Solo Jazz musical semantics
dance_gate5_semantics.note: Explicit MusicMap accent, break and rhythm evidence can now modulate approved MotorOS phrase arguments. Missing or low-confidence swing evidence produces no swing warp. The Site demo uses synthetic labeled evidence; this is not proof of audio-derived musical understanding or professional Swing/Solo Jazz interpretation.

hand.label: Dexterous hand
hand.note: Current runtime hand is visible through finger chains/contact measurements; explicit production 3D finger-bone rig remains a later visual gate.

next_gate.label: Next Jazz gate
next_gate.note: Finish Jazz v1 before appearance work: expand the bounded phrase vocabulary only as needed, then verify uploaded-song -> MusicMap -> conductor -> MotorOS -> stable full-body playback end to end on Human Motion Core.
